name: Mole Rat Meat
blurb: The Mole Rat in Fallout 76 — drops Mole Rat Meat, 142 NPC variants, 388 known spawn points.

creatures.note: Every Mole Rat you kill drops Mole Rat Meat (100%). Mole Rat: 142 variants, levels 1–150, up to 800 HP.

farming_tips.spawn_note: Mole Rat Meat comes from killing Mole Rats and looting the body.

ranks.desc: 40% chance to find extra meat from animal corpses.
60% chance to find extra meat from animal corpses.
80% chance to find extra meat from animal corpses.
Food and drink weights are reduced by 45%.
Food and drink weights are reduced by 90%.
Food in your inventory will spoil 45% slower.

consumption.note: Mole Rat Meat is a food consumable. It grants no timed stat buff on its own.
